entry.author: Climate Change Commission
entry.summary:
We're currently asking for public feedback on three pieces of work related to Aotearoa New Zealand’s 2050 emissions reduction target and the next emissions budget. In this webinar, we provide an overview of this consultation, followed by breakout sessions on each of the three projects, and ending with Q&A.

Learn more about these projects and this consultation: https://www.climatecommission.govt.nz/news/have-your-say-how-can-aotearoa-new-zealand-best-tackle-greenhouse-gases/

Make a submission here: https://haveyoursay.climatecommission.govt.nz/

Follow us on Eventbrite to hear about upcoming webinars and events: https://www.eventbrite.co.nz/o/climate-change-commission-29793944859

00:00 Welcome
01:22 Overview of the Commission
04:22 Overview of this consultation
13:00 Introducing breakout sessions
14:26 Session 1: What should the level of the fourth emissions budget be?
42:38 Session 2: Does NZ's 2050 emissions target need to change?
1:09:18 Session 3: Should emissions from international shipping and aviation be included in the 2050 target?
1:33:30 Q&A
